subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the 14 action upgrades land as one grouped update after exact-head checks, despite several scheduled and release workflows lacking direct PR-run coverage?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent, but accepting grouped executable-code changes across credential, publishing, scanning, and agent boundaries is a repository risk decision that CI cannot fully settle.

options.title: Land after focused workflow proof
options.body: Wait for exact-head required checks and confirm representative token-generation and Docker build or publishing paths before merging the grouped update.

options.title: Accept the grouped pin refresh
options.body: Merge after required checks based on full-SHA provenance and upstream compatibility, accepting that some scheduled and release paths are not directly exercised.

options.title: Split sensitive action families
options.body: Separate token, Codex, and release action updates from routine setup and labeling actions to reduce review and rollback blast radius.

recommendation.title: Land after focused workflow proof
recommendation.body: Wait for exact-head required checks and confirm representative token-generation and Docker build or publishing paths before merging the grouped update.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is recent ownership of Docker release workflow hardening and release validation.
